page_title: TOT 3-2 BRE | Tottenham Hotspur v Brentford 31/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Josh Dasilva (Brentford) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+8' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Brentford will take a corner kick.
90+7' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
90+6' Ivan Toney (Brentford) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+6' David Coote shows a yellow card to Jamie Donley (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
90+6' Josh Dasilva (Brentford) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+5' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+5' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+4' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+3' Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the top of the net, but Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
90+2' Richarlison (Tottenham) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.
90+2' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Timo Werner and he is replaced by Jamie Donley (Tottenham).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) was quite harsh and David Coote didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' A substitution has been made. Keane Lewis-Potter is replaced by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
88' That's the end of the game for Vitaly Janelt, who is replaced by Shandon Baptiste (Brentford).
88' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make a change. James Maddison is unable to continue due to injury, Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) comes on.
87' The game is interrupted now, James Maddison (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Timo Werner (Tottenham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
84' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
83' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Tottenham get a corner.
83' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
83' A cross from James Maddison (Tottenham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
82' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. David Coote blows his whistle for an infringement.
81' Ivan Toney (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
79' Josh Dasilva (Brentford) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
78' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen is replaced by Josh Dasilva (Brentford).
78' That will be all from Nathan Michael Collins who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
78' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) brings an opponent down and David Coote interrupts the game.
76' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
75' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken is well positioned and punches the ball away.

75' Timo Werner (Tottenham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
74' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) commits a rough foul. David Coote stops the game and makes a call.
73' 16:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
71' Ben Mee (Brentford) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
69' James Maddison (Tottenham) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.

67' 3 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Ivan Toney (Brentford) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:2.
65' Ivan Toney (Brentford) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post.
63' Ivan Toney (Brentford) gets a nice pass from Keane Lewis-Potter on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
62' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
59' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
57' Substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) has come on for Mathias Jensen.
56' 3 - 1 Goal! Richarlison (Tottenham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:1.
56' James Maddison (Tottenham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
54' A rebound falls kindly for Richarlison (Tottenham), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
53' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
52' A quickly taken corner by Tottenham.
52' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.

49' 2 - 1 Goal! Timo Werner displays great vision and sends a pass to Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:1.
48' 1 - 1 Goal! Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
48' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) comes off for Brennan Johnson.
46' Half-time substitution. Ange Postecoglou decided to make a change. Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) is replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
45+3' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

45' Ivan Toney (Brentford) latches on to a well-placed cross from the free kick on the edge of the box and attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick header towards the net. Unfortunately for him, the keeper was quicker and denies him.
44' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brentford.
43' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
43' Neal Maupay (Brentford) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
41' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Coote blows for a foul.
38' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Richarlison (Tottenham).
37' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
36' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.
35' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Mathias Jensen (Brentford), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
34' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee David Coote saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Brentford.
32' Brentford are ruled offside.
32' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
31' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brentford are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
30' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
28' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

25' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
24' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
24' It could have been a good chance to score! James Maddison (Tottenham) fails to release Richarlison with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
23' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from James Maddison (Tottenham).
22' Timo Werner (Tottenham) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post.
21' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) steps up to send the ball in.

21' Timo Werner (Tottenham) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham).
17' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. David Coote had an easy-decision to make.
17' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Neal Maupay (Brentford) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

15' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ivan Toney (Brentford) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario pulls off an easy save.
14' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Brentford players look gutted.
13' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee David Coote is going to take a look using VAR.
12' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
12' Timo Werner (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' James Maddison (Tottenham) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
10' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Neal Maupay (Brentford), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
9' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Timo Werner (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
8' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
7' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. David Coote had a clear view and blows his whistle.
5' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes a short free kick.

5' Ivan Toney (Brentford) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left David Coote no option but to blow his whistle. Tottenham are awarded a free kick.
4' Wow, what an escape. Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
2' Timo Werner (Tottenham) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
David Coote will referee today's match.
